name: Hootentown Canoe Rental
description: Family-run outfitter at the Hooten Town access on the lower James, running canoe, raft, tube and kayak floats with shuttle since 1993, over routes of roughly 4 to 13 miles. Trades as Hootentown Canoe Rental, Campground and Store, with tent sites, full-hookup RV pads and a camp store.

name: James River Outfitters
description: Family-owned float outfitter at the Galena Y-Bridge on the James, renting kayaks, canoes, rafts, tubes and jon boats with shuttle, over trips from a few hours to overnight. Tent sites and RV hookups on the river.

name: Devil's Back Floats
description: Family-run since 1980 and the only float service on the Bourbeuse, an hour from St Louis at Noser Mill. Canoe, kayak and jon boat rentals, primitive riverside camping and a concrete boat ramp. Reservations required for floats; the ramp and campground stay open.
